lastCompletedStory.title: Flip the reviewer spawn through the container (fail-closed)

nextStoryContext: US-005 (B-2 CAM-152) is complete. review.ts now: (1) accepts workerIsolation ('host'|'container'), preflightContainerFn, and escalateFn in MakeReviewDispatchOptions; (2) runs preflight before each reviewer respawn-pane when preflightContainerFn is provided; (3) is fail-closed in container mode: if preflightContainerFn returns ready:false, calls escalateFn (fire-and-forget) and returns { status: 'error', detail: 'container-not-ready: ...' } without dispatching an un-wrapped host reviewer; (4) wraps shellCmd via dockerExecWrap when workerIsolation==='container'. host.ts: hoisted preflightContainerFn and workerIsolation declarations before makeReviewDispatch to avoid TS2448 block-scoped-before-assignment error; wired both into the review dispatch options. Tests added: 6 new tests in 'makeReviewDispatch: US-005 container mode dispatch' describe block. All quality gates pass. All 5 user stories on this PRD now have passes:true; the PRD is ready for review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: docker exec -it confirmed: -i keeps STDIN open, -t allocates a pseudo-TTY. The 'docker exec -it cam-worker <shellCmd>' form used by dockerExecWrap is correct for the interactive reviewer dispatch pattern.
